articles.title: Scotland without captain Weir for World Cup play-off
articles.summary: Scotland will be without Caroline Weir for the World Cup play-off final with Sweden following a setback in the influential midfielder's recovery from a muscle injury.

articles.title: Turkey-based Bates replaces Binks in Scotland squad
articles.summary: David Bates has been called up to the Scotland squad as fellow defender Luis Binks drops out for the matches against North Macedonia and Switzerland.
